verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an HTTP Tracking API for server-side event ingestion with a batch endpoint for submitting multiple events, and describes event types (identify/track/page/screen/group) [hightouch-docs-7,38,39,29]. However, the evidence pack does not clearly document authentication specifics for this events API (the bearer-token auth shown in docs-33 is for the general REST API, not confirmed for the tracking endpoint) nor explicit delivery guarantees (retries, idempotency, at-least-once semantics) for event ingestion. Missing for 10: documented auth scheme specific to the events HTTP API, explicit delivery/retry guarantees for ingested events, and independent corroboration of reliability at scale.
